range_definition: a zone starts at a past-only range label; its initial support/resistance are frozen and it stays active until a later close exits the frozen bounds
breakout_outcome: first future close above frozen resistance or below frozen support; otherwise no breakout within H bars

features_at_prediction_time.duration_days: calendar days since the active frozen channel started
features_at_prediction_time.position_in_channel: current close in lower, middle or upper third of frozen range
features_at_prediction_time.regression_channel_slope: least-squares slope of previous 20 closes, normalized by current ATR
features_at_prediction_time.weekday: weekday of the completed signal bar, Monday=0 through Sunday=6

evaluation: compare channel position with all range events; compare duration, slope and weekday both with all range events and with events in the same channel-position third, on the same ticker, timeframe, horizon and sample
limitations: overlapping forecast horizons and repeated bars in one range episode are dependent
late sample dates were explored earlier in this repository and are not a blind holdout
day-of-week and duration are hypotheses to test; no pattern is assumed profitable
no EMA signal, trade execution or paper account is involved
